title: Verification record set
description: Produced by scripts/verify.mjs. One record per manifest entry. The records are the source of truth: deliverable text is generated from them, never transcribed.

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run

manifest.description: Path to the manifest that produced this set

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the set

label.description: Human-readable description of what this is

locator.description: Parameters that address the item at that source

profile.description: Normalisation profile applied when comparing this item

notes.description: Caveats a reader needs, e.g. known divergences

fetchedUtc.description: ISO 8601 UTC. A verification is a snapshot; sources change.

fetchedVia.description: Transport that succeeded (e.g. 'fetch', 'curl (fetch returned 403)'). Needed to reproduce the check.

fields.description: Retrieved text as it came from the source, keyed by field name

fingerprints.description: SHA-256 prefix per field, computed over the retrieved (not normalised) text

assertions.description: Expectations tested against the retrieved text. A failing assertion is the most valuable output the system produces.

verdict.description: Match rung at which the assertion was decided

crossCheck.description: Independent confirmation. Required for any item carrying argumentative weight.

index.description: Path to the content index used, for reproducibility

matchedIds.description: Identifiers of the matching items in the independent source. These are that source's own identifiers, which may differ from the primary source's numbering -- the whole reason matching is by content.

verdict.description: INDEPENDENT-CONFIRM, NOT-FOUND-IN-INDEPENDENT-SOURCE, or a match rung for provider comparisons

status.description: VERIFIED = retrieved and every assertion passed. RETRIEVED = fetched, nothing asserted. MISMATCH = an assertion or cross-check failed; investigate before publishing. FAILED = could not retrieve; report, never silently drop.
